'''Trailblaze''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots, meant to make the wearer faster on paths, gravel and mud bricks. Its internal name is ''Traversal''. In 1.12.3 the enchantment no longer changes the wearer's speed (see [[#Speed|Speed]]), and its tooltip line reads "Soul Speed".

== Obtaining ==
* [[Prayer of St. Clement]], a crafted [[blessing]] (Trailblaze III). It stores <code>matcha:traversal</code> directly, so applying it to boots that already have Trailblaze does not go past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>
* The Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]], traded from the [[Mouthpiece]] for [[The Tanakh]] (Trailblaze III, with Loyalty III and Power II).
* [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Trailblaze I, and those found in chests have it too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_boots.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
=== Speed ===
Before 1.12.3, the enchantment added 0.0155 movement speed per level while the wearer was on a path block (to the base player speed of 0.1), so Trailblaze III made them about 46% faster. The 1.12.3 version of the enchantment has no speed attribute. While the wearer is on a path block (or still on the ground after leaving one), it only runs a function that sets the wearer's <code>traversal</code> score to 1, and a timer resets that score to 0 every 2 seconds. Nothing in the pack reads the score, so the boots do not speed the wearer up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/traversal.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/2s/traversal.mcfunction}}</ref> The enchantment does not apply while riding or flying. See [[Known bugs]].

The path blocks are the pack's <code>#matcha:is_path</code> tag:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/is_path.json}}</ref>
* {{MCW|Dirt Path|dirt path}} and {{MCW|Coarse Dirt|coarse dirt}}
* {{MCW|Gravel|gravel}}
* {{MCW|Packed Mud|packed mud}}
* {{MCW|Mud Bricks|mud bricks}}, mud brick slabs and mud brick stairs
* [[Dirt Slab]]s

=== Durability and particles ===
Each time the wearer moves while on the ground on a path block, the boots have a 4% chance per level to lose 1 durability. Walking on a path block kicks up dirt particles every 5 ticks.

Trailblaze's anvil cost multiplier is 8 (it was 0 before 1.12.3), and the enchanting table cost is 10 plus 10 per level above the first (it was 1 plus 1).

== Issues ==
* The enchantment's description is the vanilla key <code>enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed</code>, not <code>enchantment.kleispack.traversal</code>, so boots show "Soul Speed" instead of "Trailblaze" (the language file still defines "Trailblaze" under the old key). The developer's commit that changed it says it was edited to get the enchantment running on 26.3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>
* The developer's notes for earlier versions record that the speed boost from mud brick slabs applied after a jump but not when running normally.<ref>{{Cite changelog|quote=When running on mud brick slabs with traversal boots, when I jump I get the speed boost, but when I just run on it normally I don't get the speed boost}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.5-alpha|The Prayer of St. Clement now works.}}
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from Traversal to Trailblaze in the language files; the internal id is unchanged.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Rennamed Traversal to Trailblaze (Only in Lang)}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Now works on mud brick slabs and stairs and dirt slabs. Speed raised from 0.0105 to 0.0155 per level.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Buffed Trailblaze speed (0.0105 / lvl -> 0.0155 / lvl)}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved from the <code>main</code> to the <code>matcha</code> namespace, although the Prayer of St. Clement still gave the old enchantment.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|The Prayer of St. Clement stores Trailblaze directly, so it no longer raises boots past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>
The speed attribute was removed from the enchantment when it was reworked for 26.3, so it no longer speeds the wearer up. Its anvil cost multiplier rose from 0 to 8, and the tooltip name became "Soul Speed".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>}}
}}
